purpose: Expose interference beyond the eight-item acquisition mechanism; no selected retries or capacity claims from a tiny codebook. Reuse all six fixed seed/dimension combinations and both writable rules, no slow fitting.
native_limits: Unchanged from m1-bdh-synaptic-v1; at most512 events per episode and8192 per file. No cap increase or reset inside a logical episode.
controls: Identical balanced shuffled labels, keys, order and noise across rules. Latest-observation nearest-neighbor using supplied raw keys. Queries contain no labels. After four passes measure observed and perturbed recall, then one changed association and retention of all other keys.
acceptance: Publish every result, reference parity, fixed state bytes at each geometry, unchanged hereditary bytes, and all failures. No score threshold promotes M1, M2 or production.
